messages:
Aisha: Thanks for the all-hands update — a few quick hiring/org questions here so folks don't DM privately.

Noah: Quick recap: leadership is reallocating ~12 open infra roles into product infra and Dedicated capacity. Not a headcount cut, just shifting priorities.

Priya: Timeline Q: when will teams see updated headcount maps? Need to update roadmaps and sprint capacity.

Connor: We'll publish the new org map by EOD Wednesday and a CSV with seat assignments + owners. Expect a "what changes" bullet list for each team.

Daria: For managers: if you have a role that should keep priority status, ping people-ops. We are honoring mission-critical exceptions.

Marta: How are we handling manager bandwidth? A few teams are temporarily losing senior ICs to new squads.

Noah: We're using a two-month rotation plan for senior ICs moving to product infra; most assignments are temporary with backfills prioritized. Managers will get a compensation/recognition guideline for interim responsibilities.

Aisha: What about performance cycles & promotion windows? Any freeze or altered timelines?

Priya: No freezes. Promotions continue. We'll add a FAQ entry on promotion visibility for folks moved between squads. If you're mid-cycle, your manager will get a checklist to surface contributions.

Jules: Contractor conversions? Any budget caps?

Connor: Conversions are still on the table, but teams need to justify headcount against committed Dedicated hires. Prioritization rubric: customer-impact + continuity + ramp cost.

Ben: Referral bonus timeline? Folks hiring for Q4 roles should know if payout changes.

Daria: No change to the program today. We may delay payout scheduling for certain roles if cashflow needs shift; we'll communicate 2 weeks in advance.

Marta: Will there be org charts per region? APAC has different staffing needs.

Noah: Yes — regional breakdowns will be included. APAC hires that are revenue/ops critical remain prioritized.

Aisha: Any change to interviewing process SLA? Our hiring funnel is slowing at coordinator stage.

Priya: Hiring coordinators: please escalate bottlenecks to talent-ops@redwood.company. We're adding two contract recruiters to help triage mid-funnel for prioritized roles.

Jules: Can managers request protected hiring lanes for ramping product initiatives?

Connor: Yep. Protected lanes for up to 3 reqs per organization will be considered if you submit a short justification doc to people-ops.

Ben: Curious about career ladder clarity when squads merge. Will L4/L5 expectations change?

Daria: No wholesale changes to levels. Team expectations will be annotated on the org map so leveling discussions stay consistent.

Aisha: Thanks — can we get a short digest + recording for folks in different timezones?

Noah: We'll host two office hours (EMEA/APAC-friendly) and post the recording + one-page digest afterwards.

Priya: If you want a private chat about risks to your team, DM me or use the anonymous form: https://forms.redwood.company/internal-hiring-risk (placeholder).

Connor: Action items recap: 1) Org map + seat CSV by Wed EOD. 2) Promotion FAQ + rubric by Friday. 3) Office hours schedule + recording. 4) Protected lane request process doc.

Aisha: Appreciated. Leaving this thread for folks to drop role-specific calls outs.

Marta: FYI — I'll post a short list of contractors I'm recommending for conversion into this thread tomorrow morning.

Noah: Thanks all. If you need faster answers, join the office hours or ping people-ops. (reaction: :eyes:)
